# Acceptance archive

English · [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

[Maintainer guide](../README.md) · [Current release rules](../releases.md)

These are historical records, preserved in their original language. The tables
identify each record's language. Dates, versions, environments, failures,
and unrun checks retain their original meaning. A record is not proof that the
current source or a later release passed the same checks.

Use current maintainer guides for implementation contracts. For a new release or
migration, create a new record instead of overwriting old evidence. Two records
below preserve test sections formerly mixed into the runtime and report guides.
